name: cloudflare-images-upload
description: Upload images to Cloudflare Images with drag & drop or paste - works in Markdown, HTML, CSS, JS, and more

cloudflareImagesUpload.apiToken.description: Your Cloudflare API Token with Images:Edit permission

cloudflareImagesUpload.accountHash.description: Your Cloudflare Account Hash (found in the Images dashboard URL)

cloudflareImagesUpload.defaultVariant.description: Default variant to use for image URLs

cloudflareImagesUpload.deleteOnRemoval.description: Ask to delete image from Cloudflare when URL is removed from document (disabled by default)

cloudflareImagesUpload.deleteWithoutConf.description: Skip the confirmation dialog when deleting images on removal. Only applies when 'Delete On Removal' is enabled.

cloudflareImagesUpload.addMetadata.description: Attach metadata to uploaded images. The default metadata includes extension name, version, upload time, and file name. Customize the template below to add your own fields.

cloudflareImagesUpload.metadataTemplate.markdownDescription:
Metadata key-value pairs attached to each upload. **By default**, images are tagged with the extension name, version, upload time, and file name.

To customize, click `Edit in settings.json` and modify the keys/values. You can add your own fields or remove existing ones.

**Supported dynamic variables:**
- `${fileName}` — Original file name
- `${timestamp}` — ISO 8601 upload time
- `${date}` — Date only (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `${time}` — Time only (HH:MM:SS)
- `${extensionVersion}` — Extension version
- `${fileSize}` — File size in bytes
- `${fileExtension}` — File extension (e.g. `.png`)
- `${workspaceName}` — Current workspace name

⚠️ Cloudflare limits metadata to 1024 bytes total.

cloudflareImagesUpload.useSignedUrls.description: Generate signed URLs to prevent unauthorized access to other variants (requires signing key)

cloudflareImagesUpload.signingKey.description: (Optional) Manual signing key override. Leave empty to auto-fetch from Cloudflare API using your API token.

cloudflareImagesUpload.signedUrlExpirati.description: Signed URL expiration time in seconds. Set to 0 for no expiration (default).

cloudflareImagesUpload.enableCompression.description: Automatically compress images that exceed the max file size before uploading. Supported: JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC/HEIF, BMP. PNG/HEIC/BMP are converted to JPEG. GIF and SVG are skipped.

cloudflareImagesUpload.maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum file size in MB before compression is triggered. Note: Cloudflare's official limit is 10MB, though uploads up to 20MB may work but are not guaranteed. See https://developers.cloudflare.com/images/upload-images/

cloudflareImagesUpload.compressionQualit.description: Compression quality (1-100). Lower values = smaller files but reduced quality. Applies to JPEG output and WebP.

cloudflareImagesUpload.preservePNGFormat.description: When compressing PNG images, keep the PNG format instead of converting to JPEG. PNG compression is lossless but may result in larger files.

markdownEnumDescriptions: **Best balance of quality and size.** Modern format with excellent compression. Supports transparency. ~30% smaller than JPEG at similar quality.
**Widest compatibility, smallest files.** Lossy compression — transcoding from AVIF will compound quality loss. No transparency support.
**Lossless, no quality loss.** Files will be significantly larger (5-10x vs JPEG). Best if your AVIF source was lossless.
cloudflareImagesUpload.AVIFConversionFor.markdownDescription: Format to convert AVIF images to before uploading. Cloudflare Images does not accept AVIF as input, so AVIF files are automatically converted.
